Comment.MultiLanguageText: IO state of the HW object
=true if more than one error is present

AttributeList.Text: Called by the CPU when an I/O module reports a diagnostic. Latches Diag_DB.ModuleFault, which FB_ValveLoop turns into HwHealthy[5] and thence HwWord bit 4, driving the existing System_IO_Module_Fault alarm. Deliberately does not decode IO_State - see the body comment.
